description: AI Horde incident surface. Read top to bottom: firing alerts, then the health tiles that answer whether something is wrong right now and where, then the phase breakdowns that answer why, then outcome, database, host and log context. Threshold colours on the health tiles are set to the deployed alert thresholds, so a red tile and a firing alert agree. Datasources: app OTLP metrics and recording rules on mimir-telemetry (ai-horde-telemetry tenant), horde exporter metrics on mimir-app (ai-horde-app tenant), node and postgres exporters on mimir-infra (infrastructure tenant), application logs on loki-app (ai-horde-app tenant). App telemetry is exported by a subset of hosts, so these panels are deliberately aggregated rather than split per instance. Org 1 only (no public variant).

panels.title: Firing & Pending Alerts

panels.description: horde:job_failures:rate5m, recorded from horde_job_failures.
